objective: Request human review of a synthetic coconut observation.

actions.description: Ask a qualified human reviewer to inspect the source evidence.
preconditions: Review the original evidence and its provenance.
Do not treat the synthetic maturity label as sensor truth.
actions.expected_effect: A reviewer records a verified, rejected, or unresolved assessment.
hazards: An incorrect maturity assessment could lead to an unsuitable harvest decision.

uncertainties: No real sensor input or model output is present.
Worker and animal safety conditions have not been assessed.
